en.title: Explore life across deep time
en.heading:
Moving continents.
Branching life.
en.description: Explore reconstructed continents, navigate the tree of life, and inspect source-linked fossil records in the Evo Atlas application.
en.mapBody: Move through reconstructed coastlines and change the map view. Modelled geography retains its source and time context.
en.treeBody: Browse classification and follow available Wikipedia article links. Candidate name matches are identified separately from confirmed mappings.
en.evidenceBody: Select a taxon to inspect mapped records where verified classification and compatible reconstructed coordinates are available. Missing mappings remain explicit.
en.principleBody: A reconstructed place is a model result. A fossil point represents a recorded sample. A classification branch is not automatically a phylogenetic hypothesis. Evo keeps those meanings distinct.
en.siteRole: This GitHub Pages site introduces the project. The interactive application lives on Vercel; previous reading pages and topic collections are retired here. Wikipedia links open the original articles, without republishing their summaries.
en.missing: This address belonged to an earlier edition. Continue to the current atlas, or return to the introduction.

zh.title: 在深时中探索生命
zh.heading:
大陆在移动，
生命在分支。
zh.description: 在 Evo Atlas 中浏览重建的古大陆、沿物种树寻找类群，并查看带有来源的化石记录。
zh.eyebrow: 地质时间 · 古地理 · 生命
zh.mapBody: 切换年代与地图视图，浏览重建的海岸线。地图保留模型、来源和年代语义，帮助理解地理背景。
zh.treeBody: 浏览分类层级，打开已有的 Wikipedia 原文链接。仅凭名称找到的候选，会与已确认的对应关系区分。
zh.evidenceBody: 选择类群后，查看具有可靠分类映射和同版重建坐标的记录。缺少映射或坐标时，明确保留缺项。
zh.principleBody: 古地理位置来自模型，化石点代表具体采样记录，来源分类也不自动等于系统发育假说。应用保留这些信息各自的含义与局限。
zh.siteRole: 这里是项目介绍与应用入口，交互应用由 Vercel 提供。旧阅读页和专题不再由 GitHub Pages 发布；Wikipedia 链接前往原文，不转载摘要正文。
zh.missing: 这个地址属于先前的版本。请进入当前古地图应用，或返回项目介绍。
